Artificial intelligence changes how businesses operate, and it's moving faster than most teams expected. Companies use it daily to cut manual work and open new options. It changes how teams solve problems.

Efficiency rises, costs drop, decisions come faster than before. But these gains carry real challenges too (staffing, training, trust in the output). Companies that skip this work fall behind competitors, sometimes within a single product cycle. Nobody signs up for that on purpose.

Where does it stop? Nobody knows yet.
